# Bunch shapes and shared utilities (slacsupport) keyword reference

Input-file keywords read by Bunch shapes and shared utilities (slacsupport), grouped by the block that contains them, with the type and default value taken from the code. A blank *Default* means the code supplies no fixed value when the keyword is absent, or the entry is a block or switch. *Presence* `required` means the run stops without it. What each keyword does is explained in the module guides and the command syntax pages.
